commit_message_on_validation:
%ADDR of a global field, element or data structure, and
%ADDR(varying:*DATA) past the length prefix, is ptrs.rs ptr_to of the
field's place, written again as Runtime::addr_of. A pointer stored into a
field with no index makes room for the largest variable based on it, as
interp.rs assign does (room_for_based, with ptrs.rs addr written again).
native-diff's level 1 found this step missing, as a buffer 2 bytes short.
The tripwire now watches ptr_to, addr, assign and room_for_based.

native-diff's observation clears each global pointer's owner bytes: the
owner is the activation number, different between two runs in one
process. Pointers are compared by kind, buffer and offset.
